templates.title: Chelsea Win (Regulation)

templates.title: Match Draw (90m Regulation)
templates.question: Will Arsenal vs Chelsea end in a regulation draw?
templates.canonical_rulebook: Resolves YES if Arsenal and Chelsea are tied at the end of 90 minutes regulation time (excluding extra time and penalty shootouts).

templates.title: Over 2.5 Total Goals (90m)
templates.question: Will there be over 2.5 total regulation goals in Arsenal vs Chelsea?
templates.canonical_rulebook: Resolves YES if combined regulation goals in Arsenal vs Chelsea strictly exceed 2.5 (i.e. 3 or more goals). Extra time and shootout penalties are excluded.

templates.title: Both Teams To Score (BTTS)
templates.question: Will both Arsenal and Chelsea score in regulation time?
templates.canonical_rulebook: Resolves YES if both Arsenal and Chelsea score at least 1 goal during 90m regulation time.

templates.title: Goal in First 20 Minutes
templates.question: Will a goal be scored in the first 20:00 of Arsenal vs Chelsea?
templates.canonical_rulebook: Resolves YES if a confirmed, non-disallowed goal is scored in Period 1 with match clock <= 20:00 in Arsenal vs Chelsea.

templates.title: Bukayo Saka First Goal Scorer
templates.question: Will Bukayo Saka score the first goal in Arsenal vs Chelsea?
templates.canonical_rulebook: Resolves YES if Bukayo Saka scores the first non-own-goal of regulation time in Arsenal vs Chelsea. Resolves VOID if Bukayo Saka does not play or enters as a substitute after the first goal has already been scored.

templates.title: Bukayo Saka Anytime Goal
templates.question: Will Bukayo Saka score anytime in Arsenal vs Chelsea?
templates.canonical_rulebook: Resolves YES if Bukayo Saka scores at least 1 non-own-goal in regulation time in Arsenal vs Chelsea. Resolves VOID if Bukayo Saka does not participate (0 minutes played / DNP).
